# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository implements the Drakom AI Dev Kit, a 5-layer vendor-neutral architecture for AI-assisted development.
Before generating code, inspect and follow repository guidelines defined in:
- `AGENTS.md` (Standards Index and task routing)
- `.ai/rules/coding.md` (Language idioms and prohibited patterns)
- `.ai/rules/testing.md` (Mock isolation and testing conventions)
